description: This file declares the AudioTrackSourceImpl class, which implements the webrtc::AudioSourceInterface for managing audio source functionalities, including volume control, observer registration, sink management, and frame processing. It also defines a wrapper class for integrating AudioTrackSourceImpl with the AudioSink interface.

classes.name: AudioTrackSourceImpl
classes.description: Implements a WebRTC audio source with volume control, observer management, sink handling, and frame processing capabilities.

classes.name: AudioTrackSourceImplSinkWrapper
classes.description: Wraps an AudioTrackSourceImpl as an AudioSink, enabling integration with components expecting an AudioSink interface.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level of the audio source within the range [0, 10].

methods.name: RegisterAudioObserver
methods.description: Registers an AudioObserver to receive audio data updates.

methods.name: AddSink
methods.description: Adds an AudioTrackSinkInterface to receive audio frames.

methods.name: RemoveSink
methods.description: Removes a previously added audio sink.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Returns the current audio options for the source.

methods.name: OnFrame
methods.description: Processes an incoming audio frame with a timestamp.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the current state of the media source.

methods.name: remote
methods.description: Indicates whether the source is remote.

methods.name: RegisterObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for WebRTC events.

methods.name: UnregisterObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer for WebRTC events.

methods.name: AudioTrackSourceImplSinkWrapper
methods.description: A wrapper class that adapts AudioTrackSourceImpl to the AudioSink interface.
